critical_code_review_comments: Minor a11y: DialogContent (T&C modal) missing Description/aria-describedby prop — console warning shown twice on /partner. Not blocking.

PhoneField.jsx: capIndia guard operates only for India (+91). If future country ceilings are needed, consider generalising via libphonenumber getCountryCallingCode + maxNationalNumberLength lookup instead of the hardcoded 91 branch.

The partner-terms-consent testid is on the <label> element, which also contains a <a> link (Partner Terms & Conditions) that opens a modal. Automated tests must click the inner <input type='checkbox'> to avoid opening the T&C dialog. Consider moving data-testid to the <input> for cleaner test targeting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 10-digit hard cap for Indian mobile numbers is fully working in both /partner (partner-phone) and PhoneAuthModal (phone-input) via PhoneField.jsx onKeyDown capIndia guard. Regression flows (partner submit, OTP demo login) still pass. Only known non-blocking issue: DialogContent missing aria-describedby warning.
rca of the issue: PREVIOUS ROOT CAUSE (iter_12): react-phone-number-input's limitMaxLength suppressed onChange for over-length keystrokes, so the onChange sanitizer was unreachable while raw DOM input kept accepting keys. CURRENT FIX (iter_13): PhoneField wrapper <div> now has onKeyDown={capIndia} which fires BEFORE the input receives the key. When (a) selected country is India (value starts with +91), (b) the pressed key is a single digit, (c) no text is selected, and (d) national digit count is already >=10, the handler calls e.preventDefault() and the DOM input never receives the extra keystroke. Verified: overtype of 14 digits yields exactly 10 national digits in the DOM input value in both entry points.
